title: Model artifact metadata (model_meta.json)
description: Canonical metadata sidecar for one trained model artifact bundle. See docs/model-artifact-contract.md for the full spec and producer/consumer notes.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump on breaking field changes.

clearml_task_id.description: ClearML task id the model was trained under. "local" when trained with --no-clearml.

model_family.description: Matches --model on main.py for the base supervised trainers. Stacked/hybrid variants should use the base family that owns the leaf model artifact.

model_version.description: Free-form version tag assigned at model-selection time (e.g. by scripts/select_best_imtu_model.py). Absent for ad-hoc training runs.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this metadata was built.

git_revision.description: Full git commit SHA of the pipeline code that produced this model, when known.

metrics.description: Test-set metrics. Nullable fields cover metrics that don't apply to every model family or threshold method.

threshold.description: The single operating point this artifact is meant to be served at, plus the decision-band cuts derived from it (see fraud_pipeline/metrics/decision_bands.py). Canonical replacement for the task/threshold/operating_threshold/best_threshold naming spread across the codebase.

value.description: The tuned decision threshold. Canonical value — same number as decision_band_info.deny_min when decision bands are enabled.

method.description: threshold_method used to tune `value` (e.g. business_fpr_cap, fp_clv, f1).

bands.description: Human-readable band descriptions, e.g. {"ACCEPT": "score < 0.31", ...} — same shape as decision_band_info.bands.

artifacts.description: Maps a stable artifact name to where it lives. `path` is relative to this model_meta.json file when the bundle is exported to a directory (e.g. packages/*/models/); `clearml_name` is the name it was uploaded under via task.upload_artifact, when applicable.
